title: Sculk Music Door Skip w/ Lineup
instructions: Get stuck on the lower edge between this 3 block structure, line up your cursor with the upper-right gray pixel in the block texture, then DuckJump and steer midair.
notes: You must free the trapped Tuners from the cages, but you don't need to carry them all back by doing this.
